# <!--name-->Changelog submit<!--/name-->
<!--description-->
Self-contained action that generates a changelog entry and either commits it to the PR branch or posts it as a PR comment. Runs in the trusted workflow_run context with write permissions — no artifact from the validate workflow is needed.
<!--/description-->

## Inputs
<!--inputs-->
| Name                 | Description                                                        | Required | Default               |
|----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|-----------------------|
| `config`             | Path to changelog.yml configuration file                           | `false`  | `docs/changelog.yml`  |
| `strip-title-prefix` | Remove [Prefix]: from PR titles                                    | `false`  | `true`                |
| `github-token`       | GitHub token with contents:write and pull-requests:write           | `false`  | `${{ github.token }}` |
| `comment-only`       | Post changelog as a PR comment instead of committing to the branch | `false`  | `false`               |
<!--/inputs-->

## Outputs
<!--outputs-->
| Name        | Description                                    |
|-------------|------------------------------------------------|
| `committed` | Whether a changelog was committed (true/false) |
| `pr-number` | The PR number                                  |
<!--/outputs-->
